title: Tire Rotation Authorization Form
subtitle: Tire Rotation Service: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Tire Rotation Authorization Form turns vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern into a customer-facing Tire Rotation Service consent record. The tire service advisor itemizes diagnostics or services, labor, parts or materials, fees, tax, estimated total, maximum cap, and the customer / vehicle owner's signed decision. Work not listed or priced remains on hold.
use_case: Use Tire Rotation Authorization Form at service bay, lift, wheel positions, inflation point, and customer handoff. Verify applicable Tire Rotation Service requirements; distinguish diagnostic or inspection authority from listed work, price each operation, and record the customer / vehicle owner's exact approval, conditions, or decline. Follow the selected contact-before-additional-work instruction whenever vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern scope or cost changes.

sections.title: Authorization request and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Tire Rotation Service, identify responsible parties, service bay, lift, wheel positions, inflation point, and customer handoff, and the linked vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern source.

fields.label: Tire brand, size, position, DOT or unit identity when needed

sections.title: Requested scope, limits, and decision lines
sections.guidance: Capture Tire Rotation Service facts for vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Tire Rotation Service authorization checks
items: Tread depth and wear pattern by position
Sidewall, bead, puncture, and visible damage
Wheel, hub, stud, nut, and mounting surface
Rotation pattern and directional or staggered restriction
Fastener tightening evidence and warning-system reset

sections.title: Authorization conditions and final decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Tire Rotation Service conditions; have tire service advisor assign the next Tire Rotation Service owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Size or pattern prevents planned rotation
Stud, nut, wheel, or hub damage
Specified fastening or pressure verification incomplete
blocks.guidance: Pause Tire Rotation Service when tire roadworthiness, fitment, wheel attachment, inflation, or required verification remains unresolved. Retain the available Tire Rotation Service proof and route unresolved vehicle, tire position, size, condition, pressure, wheel, fastener, and rotation pattern scope to tire service advisor.

fields.label: Authorizing authority: Qualified Tire Service Reviewer
